mission.goal: Implement consequential remaining features after reading the comprehensive plan and beads; commit meaningful increments directly to main through GitHub, without PRs.

published_checkpoints.change: Native opset-13 DepthToSpace DCR/CRD and SpaceToDepth import, execution and artifact round-trip contracts.
Guarded durable review delivery attempts and exact held-file verification receipts, immutable reader/destination pins, audit retention and canonical/lifecycle contracts.
Private create-once CLI delivery, cold reconciliation without resend, metadata inspection, recovery/refusal contracts and operator documentation.

features: New approved derivatives after completed expiry
concurrent_changes_preserved.integration: Delivery audit retains only metadata and does not retain derivative pixels or original source media. CLI deleted-review inspection remains intact.
concurrent_changes_preserved.qualification: Concurrent features are not claimed as this session's implementation or independently qualified by its focused checks.

model: Bit-preserving Reshape/Transpose/Reshape lowering; static positive rank-four F32 only.
Checked block size, divisibility, shape arithmetic, complete expansion limits, helper-name reservations and cancellation.
Source-bound importer generation includes the new lowering; frozen native IR v1 and operator identities remain unchanged.
review_delivery: Stable identity excludes current attested time while each approval binds exact current authority/time.
Guarded Started is durable before exclusive output creation. Existing attempts never authorize recreation.
Verified requires complete actual held-file readback, SHA-256, size, private mode, single link, stable dev/inode and modification/change timestamps.
Fresh valid time attestation permits reconciliation of a complete prior file without writing. Missing/partial outputs remain indeterminate.
Metadata inspection remains recipient-scoped after expiry, revocation and deletion, without reading the external file or granting media disclosure.
Source, privacy, deletion and original narrowed reader-authority checks remain mandatory; generic ledger appends cannot forge delivery families or namespace.

obligations.work: Execute the actual merged delivery lifecycle and CLI contracts on a capable native host or assigned supplementary runner; inspect and repair concrete failures.
Preserve missing/partial delivery outcomes as indeterminate; no automatic resend or retroactive adoption of legacy files.
Complete broader model and repository qualification before release; focused contracts do not close the broad beads.

remaining_product_limits: Local principal labels and time intervals remain trusted-caller inputs; authenticated remote review and FLDT integration remain open.
Local file verification is not remote receipt, permanent file custody or recall of an already delivered copy.
The inherited review media profile is bounded raw grayscale output; longer/compressed/color/audio review delivery is separate.
Dynamic shapes, other ONNX types/opsets and full model qualification remain outside the new spatial-layout profile.
